x: We have been unable to start teams let alone finish them in the mens, but the ladies have been more productive and with Sian Spacey finishing 3rd in the National 10kms it has not been absolute disaster.
Congratulations to Sian Spacey on placing 3rd in the Womens 10 Kms the first senior individual medal for a lady in Belgrave. We also finished a ladies team but could only place 5th.

There have been several good performances this year, most notably by Sian Spacey who finished third in the National 10K Road Walk. She also set new club records in the 2K, 3K, 5K and 10K Walking in the space of 3 months.
Results: 1.V.Lupton Sheffied 1.22.00; 2.Sian Spacey 1.22.14; 10.Gill Brackpool 1.32.14 12.Sue Morrison 1.33.02; 13.Karen Barker 1.33.51. 4th May 1989 BATTERSEA PARK BELGRAVE 10K TRACK WALK
The past twelve months have not been a wonderful success, when the ladies have turned out a team they have usually been in the scoring three with Sian Spacey collecting some individual positions.

On the "down" front we have, regrettably, lost Sian Spacey who has returned to Canada to finish off her medical course. Replacing her in number one position though is Dee Walker, who having only taken up walking at the end of last year has already turned in some useful performances.
